notes.title: Update 20/4/2022
notes.notes:
A small update to improve the quality and playability of the game. A few bugs have also been fixed.

Bugs Fixed:
[list]
[*] 	Aspect ratio bugs
[*] 	Miss-aligned UI elements
[*] 	Makeup name entry showing when nametag isn't selected
[/list]

Improvements:
[list]
[*] 	Some code optimizations that should result in performance gains for lower-end hardware
[*] 	Overhauled 90% of UIs
[*] 	Better user feedback for basically everything
[*] 	Aspect Ratio now displayed next to resolution dimensions when selecting a resolution
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
Another round of bug fixes and much needed polish. Public lobbies should be stable after the last few updates.

Bugs Fixed:
Attempt at fixing IQ Introduction movie not playing
Crosshair not being properly centered on some resolutions
Miss-alignment of columns in the IQ Map Top 10 list/all countries list
Finland being in every single top ten spot of the IQ Map
Top ten list not actually being the top 10...

Improvements:
Make up music has been extended! Hopefully it's not as horrible doing makeup for extended periods of time.

Features:
A new badge for make up


Thank you to everyone who took the time to write a review or send us information about a bug that has been fixed today.

notes.title: More bug fixes
notes.notes:
VOIP is now fully fixed
Some people reported the jigsaw pieces drag and drop function breaking. This is fixed also

notes.title: Game in a playable state now
notes.notes:
The major bugs plaguing the game should be all gone.
The problems were caused by players able to join game that are already in progress, therefore
ruining the game for everyone in the lobby.
I apologize for this abysmal launch, but we are good now.


Bugs fixed>

Able to join games in progress
Controls froze some time
Strange collisions surrounding the audience sitter

Bugs that are not fixed but on the list>

Host unable to send voicedata to others
Graphic change bugs, text doesn't change

notes.title: Caution in buying
notes.notes:
I warn the customers that the game is not in a good state. There are some bugs
regarding players losing control and joining games that have already started.

These are bugs that are on the process of being fixed. If you still like to play,
what might work is hosting yourself or playing in private games. Basically make sure you are playing 
the game from the START (there is a yellow lobby room that you join before you go into the inside level).
